items.title: Judge Dismisses Former Olympian’s Felony Charge in Reflecting Pool Case
items.author: Chris Cameron
items.content: <article>The move ends the criminal case for David Hearn, a former Olympic canoeist, after prosecutors acknowledged that the Trump administration’s claims of vandalism were false.</article>

items.title: Edgy Vanity Plates Test Limits of Free Speech
items.author: Adam Liptak
items.content: <article>Virginia will ask the Supreme Court to hear a dispute over a seven-character license plate message.</article>

items.title: Hemp Fight Snarls Speedy Passage of Government Funding Bill
items.author: Catie Edmondson and Olivia Diaz
items.content: <article>A White House effort to delay a ban on intoxicating hemp was holding up a final agreement on a bipartisan spending bill ahead of a monthlong Senate recess.</article>

items.title: Women’s Share of Top Military Promotions Falls as Hegseth Blocks Nominees
items.author: C.J. Robinson
items.content: <article>The percentage of high-ranking officer nominations going to women is currently at its lowest level in over two decades.</article>

items.title: Moderate Democrats Prepare for ‘War’ Against an Ascendant Left
items.author: Shane Goldmacher
items.content: <article>One moderate group says the progressive wins are “deeply troubling” and is planning a $15 million effort against democratic socialism.</article>

items.title: Insults, Expletives and Fat-Shaming: Vance Trolls Critics on the Right and Left
items.author: Peter Baker
items.content: <article>The vice president has dispensed with the decorum and restraint of his predecessors to directly take on opponents and journalists on social media with sometimes profane and often personal jabs.</article>

items.title: Tennessee’s Andy Ogles Faces Well-Funded Opposition in House Primary Thursday
items.author: Patricia Mazzei, Tim Balk and Emily Cochrane
items.content: <article>Representative Andy Ogles received President Trump’s endorsement, but his challenger, Charlie Hatcher, a former state agriculture commissioner, has the backing of Gov. Bill Lee.</article>

items.title: Senate Panel Has Obtained Copy of Fauci’s Government Cellphone
items.author: Sheryl Gay Stolberg
items.content: <article>The development comes as a Senate committee prepares to vote Thursday on whether to hold Dr. Anthony S. Fauci in contempt of Congress for refusing to answer questions at a hearing.</article>

items.title: A Growing Number of Election Deniers Hold Key Local Roles in Midterms
items.author: Nick Corasaniti and Alexandra Berzon
items.content: <article>These officials oversee or help administer elections in counties across the nation where competitive House and Senate races will determine control of Congress.</article>

items.title: F.D.A. Approves Moderna’s mRNA Flu Vaccine
items.author: Christina Jewett
items.content: <article>The agency had initially refused to even review the application but reversed course after a public outcry.</article>

items.title: Federal Judge Weakens The National Firearms Act
items.author: Chris Cameron
items.content: <article>The National Firearms Act mandated a permitting process for short-barreled rifles and shotguns, as well as suppressors. A judge ruled that the provision was unconstitutional.</article>
